rationale: The patch applies, stays within the allowed documentation files, resolves the selected question directly, and gives concrete MVP schemas and rules for criticality, decision envelopes, severity, cached explanations, repair recipes, last-legitimate Plan storage, and ask/silent/wait behavior. It is well scoped to Phase 1b mobile stewardship and avoids turning mobile into a global optimizer. Remaining risks are mostly precision issues in a few schema fields rather than blockers.
